tools.fusionDefaultPrompt:
You are the NexusLocal Judge and Consolidator Agent.

Below are responses from different LLM models to the user question. Analyze each response, extract the strengths of each, neutralize factual errors or hallucinations, and build the ideal answer: unified, clear, and comprehensive.

Reply directly to the user without mentioning that you are consolidating responses. Return only the final answer in Markdown.

toolsSettings.enhancerDesc: Configure the model that will optimize your prompts before sending.
toolsSettings.enableChatButtonDesc: When disabled, the button disappears from the interface.
toolsSettings.fusionDesc: Run multiple models in parallel and consolidate responses with a Judge model.
toolsSettings.parallelModelsDesc: Each line uses a different provider. One model per provider to avoid rate limits.
toolsSettings.judgeModelDesc: The Judge analyzes all responses and generates a consolidated verdict. Can use any provider, including repeated ones.
toolsSettings.factualCheckDesc: The Judge verifies facts of the responses on the web before consolidating. Adds ~2-5s of latency.
toolsSettings.enableFusionDesc: When active, the 🧬 toggle appears in the chat.
toolsSettings.visionDesc: Configure the model that will interpret images when the active model in the chat does not support vision.
toolsSettings.enableAutoRoutingDesc: Redirect images to the interpreter when the active model does not support vision.
toolsSettings.cacheDescriptionsDesc: Avoid cost and time of reprocessing identical images resent in the chat.
toolsSettings.webSearchDesc: Configure external search to enrich responses from local models with real-time information.
toolsSettings.enableHeuristicDesc: Analyzes questions on the backend and triggers search without needing manual toggle.

toolsSettings.freeRegistryDesc: Settings for syncing the knowledge base about rate limits of free APIs.
toolsSettings.hideUnconfirmedDesc: If enabled, only models verified by the Registry will be displayed and marked as "Free" in the panel.
toolsSettings.preemptiveThresholdDesc: Defines at what percentage of quota usage the system will trigger preemptive failover.
